goal: Add the immutable PostgreSQL release registry/content schema and one repository/tool boundary, then build and validate inactive legacy-import-r0 Gear and Community Releases without changing public readers or the active manifest pointer.
userValue: Current legal gear and observed community templates can be sealed, audited and revalidated as candidate releases before any public cutover, so a failed build cannot corrupt the live combination.
nonGoals: No public browse, Resolver Authority Context, Profile or frontend reader cutover
No active Season Manifest pointer creation, promotion or rollback execution
No scheduled release refresh service or timer
No mutation or deletion of existing staging rows
No public baseline, recommendation, DPS comparison or BiS behavior
No Phase 5 SimC job or Worker
No dependency installation or unapproved local download

mustChange: additive migration 0013 for immutable release registry, release-scoped content, manifests, retail pointer and append-only events
one gear_release_store.py SQL owner for immutable insert/read and pointer CAS primitives
one explicit gear_release_tool.py for inactive build, validate, show and future shadow/promote commands
deterministic Gear legacy-import-r0 snapshot from current staging
Community legacy-import-r0 election that re-authors exact Intent and re-runs current Resolver against the candidate Gear Release
focused schema/repository/import tests plus Strict candidate migration and inactive-release evidence
mustNotChange: current mutable staging tables and sync writers
active gear workbench and legacy endpoint compatibility
deploy async-sync default and existing timer ownership
evidenceRequired: schema constraints, append-only permissions, release-scoped keys and one-winner uniqueness
idempotent identical insert and hash-collision mismatch rejection
failed build/preflight leaves public readers and pointer unchanged
40-spec legacy community re-resolution with winner/standby/rejected counts
repeatable-read staging snapshot and bounded PostgreSQL query-plan evidence
backend/full verification, local CR, exact-head CI, candidate migration backup, live inactive import and rollback evidence

consumers: future Phase 4D active manifest pointer cutover

engineeringHealth.reason: Slice 4B adds one additive schema and one repository owner; it may adapt staging reads and canonical Resolver calls but may not place release SQL in postgres_cache_store.py or activate public readers.

acceptanceEvidence: migration SQL review, Python compile, write-path/static SQL inspection and git diff --check
candidate schema backup/migration, inactive 40-spec legacy import, zero pointer/public change, health/timer/log and rollback proof

decisionLog.decision: Keep existing WebSim tables mutable staging and copy canonical snapshots into new release-scoped tables; do not retrofit release_id onto staging writers.
Seal releases by hash and append events; active lifecycle remains a separate pointer so release content never updates or deletes.
Build Gear and Community legacy-import-r0 candidates inactive; every observed candidate must re-pass the current Resolver against the exact Gear Release.
Slice 4B may create manifest rows for validation fixtures but must not create or mutate the retail active pointer.
